title: sanitize-presubmit-bootstrap-and-dep-refresh-orchestrator
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Consolidates presubmit bootstrapping across services, introduces a lightweight dependency refresh orchestrator to reduce noisy lockfile churn and centralizes secret handling for CI; no runtime breaking changes.
description: Context: Over time multiple presubmit entrypoints (bootstrap scripts, setup actions, and local dev helpers) diverged across packages and SDKs. That made CI flaky when a transient env change landed and led to repeated manual edits in several repos. This PR centralizes the presubmit bootstrap behavior into a single composable GH Actions composite + a small POSIX shim used by legacy jobs, and adds a dependency refresh orchestrator that gates automatic lockfile bumps to avoid redundant PR storms. Motivation: reduce flakiness, standardize secrets handling, and make dependency refreshes measurable and non-disruptive. What I changed (high level): 1) Introduced .github/actions/presubmit-bootstrap composite action that: - normalizes Node/Python toolchain setup (no more per-repo scripts) - performs lightweight hermetic checks (install cache warm, pnpm/poetry configured) - exposes toggles for fastpath vs full install - moves secret-access logic to a single place with explicit inputs 2) Added tools/dep-orchestrator/ directory: - small Go binary (orchestrator) wrapper script used by a scheduled workflow that coordinates dependency-bot updates to avoid duplicate lockfile PRs - simple tagging/aggregation strategy: group bump PRs by top-level package ecosystem and open a single rollup PR per group 3) Replaced many repo-level setup_env.sh and bootstrap.sh copies with thin symlink-compatible wrappers that call the composite action so historical developer flows still work 4) GH Actions changes: - updated workflow triggers: presubmit.yml now calls the composite action - added schedule job dep-orchestrator.yml (weekly by default) - added a preflight check that aborts CI when the composite action verifies an unlabeled commit (protect main) 5) Observability: - emits a presubmit.bootstrap.started/finished metric via our telemetry helper - dep-orchestrator writes a brief artifact with grouped PR metadata for manual audit Checklist: - [x] Composite action implemented and documented - [x] Backwards-compatible thin wrappers added for legacy callers - [x] Unit tests for orchestrator grouping logic - [x] Integration smoke run on staging workflows - [x] Telemetry instrumentation added Notes on safety and rollback: composite action includes a DEBUG_MODE that forces no-op; workflows default to DEBUG_MODE=false only after a canary week. Orchestrator has a dry-run mode used for the first 2 scheduled runs. Related: ENG-3421 (presubmit stabilization), SUP-1283 (dependency noise from Dependabot).
